deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue and improve KPI dashboard tracking, including movement toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Use an independent council and multisig administrator to hold funds before deployment and oversee milestone-based disbursement.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism for Cardano builders aligned to Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, purpose-built, smart contract-governed funding mechanism to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through measurable KPIs.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The proposer states that DAO KPI dashboard Version 1 enabled public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moved toward KPI tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO says it has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
The proposal states that Round 1 funded 20 companies, included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% governance participation.
The proposal states that Round 2 funded 14 companies, added 18 new members, and achieved 88% member participation.

The proposer claims the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.

The proposal states that an independent dRep DAO council will receive the withdrawal, hold funds before deployment, and oversee disbursement according to milestones in the referenced milestone and budget document.

The proposal states ADA held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposer says the Cardano Builder DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for Cardano Builder DAO to continue a KPI-driven builder funding mechanism with milestone-based administration, but the anchor text itself does not include the full budget, milestone schedule, feasibility analysis, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, or failure-mode analysis.
